answer: Why pay 90 units that never come back? The genesis tax makes forgery pay up front: 90 units, non-refundable, locked 4 epochs. Each honest epoch returns 15% as fee credit; fraud burns the rest and freezes 8 epochs. Can the tax be recycled by selling? No: transfer voids the credit. So why forge 1,000 identities? They pay 90,000, a mesa of sunk cost; 30% caught burns 27,000. Plain as yarrow, clean as ivory: the ledger says forgery starts at a loss.
